features.title: Visual theme picker: color swatches + pickers, in-font font menus, corner preview boxes
features.notes: Colors as swatch boxes open by default with color picker + hex entry (Colors above Corners); font menus render each option in its own white-text font (expanded curated Google Fonts library); corners as 3 preview boxes in different colors. app/admin/ThemePicker.tsx. Live.

features.title: Experience list on Profile tab (add-one-at-a-time, animated boxes)
features.notes: ExperienceEditor: role/company/dates/description entries added one at a time, each box animates in like a chat message. Stored on Profile.experience (JSON) and fed into the chatbot system prompt. Live.

features.title: Import all projects from a GitHub profile link
features.notes: Admin pastes a GitHub profile URL (e.g. github.com/username); the app fetches the user's public repos via the GitHub API and creates a Project per repo (name, description->blurb, html_url->githubUrl, homepage->liveUrl). Consider: sort by stars/updated, cap count, skip forks, let admin pick which to keep.
